decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extension, by reason of its size, position and design would not be subordinate to the existing house and would be out of character with the house itself, the street scene and would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Osterley Park Conservation Area and would be contrary to Policies ENV1.1, ENV1.2, H.3.4 of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan and Policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B2.2, H.6.4 of the revised deposit Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (2002).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development, by reason of its position, size, and design would result in a loss of amenity to neighbouring occupiers by reason of its overbearing impact which would result in a loss of outlook and light and would be contrary to policies ENV1.1, H3.4 of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the revised deposit Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (2002).

Condition : 3 - The parking arrangements would lead to conditions prejudicial to the safety of vehicular and pedestrian road users and would be detrimental to the character and appearance of the Conservation Area. It would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV1.1, ENV1.2, T2.5 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B2.2, T1.4 of revised deposit Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (2002).
description: Erection of a two storey side, part  two storey/single storey rear extension and a single storey front extension / canopy to existing dwellinghouse.
